as_told.title: Stargate remote viewers placed in submarines
as_told.place_text: Submarines at the bottom of the sea

plain: Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe faraway places or hidden targets with the mind alone, and Hal Puthoff, a researcher billed on the show as a CIA UFO expert, says his team tested it by sending remote viewers to the bottom of the ocean in submarines. Puthoff says he took part, and that the tests got 'some of our best results,' with the viewers remarking 'boy it's really quiet here.' He says this rules out electromagnetic brain waves as the way it works, since such signals would not reach that deep. Michels repeats the story twice on later episodes, but without Puthoff's point about brain waves.
